guidance causes distribution mismatch with high entropy (Figure 3c) and low log-probability (Figure 3a). (c) Self-explanation provides

across two methods, demonstrating that self-explanation maintains both high performance and stable entropy.

2.2. Off-Policy Learning                                             by its type and corresponding parameters.

Incorporating external demonstrations to accelerate RL
has been extensively studied. DAgger [32] addresses                  grated components: self-explanation generation produces
distribution shift through iterative aggregation, while re-          reasoning trajectories conditioned on ground-truth actions,
cent work explores combining off-policy demonstrations               maintaining distribution compatibility while providing reli-
with on-policy RL: LUFFY [44] applies off-policy gradi-              able learning signals; entropy-modulated credit assignment
ents to incorporate high-quality reasoning trajectories from         dynamically calibrates update magnitudes based on pre-
stronger models, and ExGRPO [47] utilizes experience                 diction confidence, enabling differentiated learning across
replay from the model’s own successful rollouts to enhance           diverse sample qualities.
sample efficiency. However, these approaches assume                  3.2.1. Self-Explanation Generation
external experience lies within compatible distributions.
